channel.description: Latest articles from Ocean News & Technology Magazine (oceannews.com)

item.title: Seaworthy Collective Announces Cohort 7 of the Ocean Enterprise Studio & Incubator
item.description: Seaworthy Collective, a Miami-based non-profit that supports current and aspiring entrepreneurs in BlueTech (ocean innovation), has announced its next wave of startups and founders selected for Cohort 7 of its flagship Startup Program, The Continuum Ocean Enterprise Studio and Incubator.

item.title: Damen Danish Match-Making Event Aims for Long-Term Maritime and Naval Collaboration Potential
item.description: Damen Shipyards Group, in partnership with the Danish Export Association, has held a Match-Making Day in Helsingør, Denmark. Currently, the country is preparing for a series of naval projects to be undertaken over the coming years. The event was set up to explore the potential to further strengthen long-term industrial cooperation for these projects, in a manner beneficial to Danish sovereign maritime capability and sustainable economic value.

item.title: NorthStandard White Paper Provides Expert Group Guide on Biofuel Path to Decarbonization
item.description: NorthStandard has published a new white paper focusing on the accelerating adoption of biofuels in commercial shipping. “Biofuels – Driving the green transition,” brings together insights from NorthStandard, supplier World Fuel and leading testing agency Veritas Petroleum Services (VPS), in a unique discussion document outlining biofuel uptake, potential issues and loss prevention measures.

item.title: World-First Type Approval and Factory Acceptance Testing for Ammonia-Fueled Two-Stroke Engine
item.description: Swiss marine power company WinGD has achieved a major milestone on the path to zero-carbon shipping with the completion of both Type Approval Testing (TAT) and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) of their ammonia-fueled two-stroke marine engine. item.title: Teledyne Marine to Debut New System at Oi26
item.description: Teledyne Marine will showcase its latest sonar, navigation and autonomous marine technologies at Oceanology International 2026 (Oi26), taking place in London from March 10–12, 2026. The event will also serve as the platform for an exclusive new product launch, alongside the introduction of new integrated dual head multibeam systems designed to enhance survey efficiency, data quality and operational productivity.

item.title: Lloyd’s Register Advances Safe Hybrid Nuclear Power in Partnership with Seatransport
item.description: Lloyd’s Register (LR) has announced Approval in Principle (AiP) for a hybrid nuclear ready power concept developed with Australian ship design group, Seatransport Pty Ltd.

item.title: Ireland Launches First-Ever National Maritime Security Strategy
item.description: The Minister for Defense, Helen McEntee TD, launched Ireland’s first-ever National Maritime Security Strategy, which follows from an extensive public consultation that generated approximately 300 submissions from a wide range of interests, including government bodies, academia, industry and individual members of the public.

item.title: BOEM Announces Intent to Prepare Programmatic Environmental Impact Statement for Potential Offshore Oil and Gas Leasing in California
item.description: The Bureau of Ocean Energy Management announced its intent to prepare a programmatic environmental impact statement for proposed oil and gas lease sales in the Northern, Central and Southern California Planning Areas of the Outer Continental Shelf, the initial step under the National Environmental Policy Act which initiates the process to analyze a representative California lease sale and inform decisions under the 11th National Outer Continental Shelf Oil and Gas Leasing Program.

item.title: R&D Project Takes Step Towards CO2-Neutral Propulsion
item.description: Everllence has taken a step towards the development of CO2-neutral propulsion systems with the announcement that a research-engine test bench at its Augsburg site has been successfully upgraded to enable hydrogen combustion.

item.title: Petrobras Awards Acteon 3-Year Stack-Up Mooring System Services
item.description: Intermoor, Acteon’s Moorings and Anchors business line has announced that it has been awarded a new contract by Petrobras for the provision of stack-up mooring system services in Brazil.
